+from collections import Counter
+
+def transform(grid):
+    """Copy the rare colored motif into every zero-only translation of itself."""
+    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
+    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
+    color = min(counts, key=lambda v: counts[v])
+    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
+    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
+    mask = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
+    mh = max(dr for dr, _ in mask) + 1
+    mw = max(dc for _, dc in mask) + 1
+
+    # Detect all candidates against the unchanged input, then paint their union.
+    placements = []
+    for top in range(h - mh + 1):
+        for left in range(w - mw + 1):
+            if all(grid[top+dr][left+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
+                placements.append((top, left))
+
+    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
+    for top, left in placements:
+        for dr, dc in mask:
+            out[top+dr][left+dc] = color
+    return out
*** End Patch
